verdict.rationale: Cursor's Background Agents feature explicitly lets developers hand off tasks to agents that run in isolated cloud/remote environments ('Agents use their own computers to build, test, and demo features end to end', 'Launch fleets of agents that work in parallel on ambitious tasks for hours or days', 'Accelerate development by handing off tasks to Cursor'), directly matching the story of delegating long-running tasks to a background cloud environment. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the cloud isolation mechanics, and more detail on setup/limits beyond marketing copy.
